observed: CYD B ROM read on the selected USB serial port confirmed ESP32-D0WD-V3 revision 3.1, base MAC 02:00:00:00:fe:01, 40 MHz crystal, and 4 MiB SPI flash with manufacturer 0x5e, device 0x4016 and 3.3 V strap.

The ROM base MAC matches the Guilo cyd_a unit. Guilo records working display runtime and touch on that MAC. Its tracked cyd_a and cyd_b environments include the same ILI9341_2 and XPT2046 pin configuration.

Rafa reported both yellow boards use the same PCB version. Vault adopts the portrait transform, BGR order and conservative bus clocks already used on CYD A. That configuration transfer is for first flash. CYD B still requires its own Vault display and calibration tests.
Vault uses DIO flash at 40 MHz, internal memory without PSRAM, and the same NVS and factory partition layout as CYD A. This is CYD B's first Vault profile.

pin_sources.service_tx: ROM read over the onboard bridge establishes UART0. ESP32 datasheet maps U0TXD to GPIO1.
pin_sources.service_rx: ROM read over the onboard bridge establishes UART0. ESP32 datasheet maps U0RXD to GPIO3.
